FULL TEXT:
Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission
DOWNLOAD OF HALL TICKETS FOR THE WRITTEN EXAMINATION (COMPUTER
BASED TEST) FOR THE POSTS OF ASSISTANT PROFESSORS IN VARIOUS
UNIVERSITIES AND LECTURERS IN RGUKT -2026
WEB NOTE
The Written Examination (Computer Based Test) to the post of Assistant Professors
in Various Universities and RGUKT Lecturers is Scheduled to be held from 01/12/2026 FN
& AN to 05/12/2026 FN (Except 02/12/2026) and 09/12/2026 FN & AN at erstwhile 13
District centers. Fore Noon Timings from 9.30 A.M to 12.30 PM and After Noon Timings
from 03.00P.M to 6.00P.M. The Hall Tickets will be Hosted on 24/11/2026 in the
Commission’s Website https://psc.ap.gov.in for downloading. The candidates are
advised to download the Hall Tickets well in advance and go through the Instructions
thereon. Candidates are advised to bring only the Hall Ticket Sheet to the Examination
Centre. The rest of the instruction sheets need not be brought. Candidates are also
advised to locate their allotted examination venue in advance to ensure that they reach
the Centre on time on the day of the examination.
Date: 20/11/2026 Sd/-
Place: Vijayawada SECRETARY(FAC)
